page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.large is an entry-level instance within the ecs.n1 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, featuring 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs with 1.0 thread per core. The system configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core allocation. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.n1.large demonstrates modest performance characteristics. Both single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng place the instance in the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores fall into the poor and weak categories, respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a weak read-only performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth reaches average levels. The processor supports AVX and AVX512F instructions, which is reflected in an average score on the PassMark CPU extended instructions test, despite a weak overall PassMark CPU score.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.n1.large represents a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without demanding high-performance compute or memory capacity. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions it as a budget-friendly compute-oriented instance. It is best suited for lightweight applications, basic web serving, development environments, and minor database operations that do not require high IOPS or extensive memory.
